label: Joined the May Fourth New Culture Movement in dismantling rigid Confucian gender hierarchy
description: As China’s first woman university professor and contributor to New Youth, Chen critiqued oppressive Confucian lineage norms while preserving humanist learning.
dialecticalTension: Balances May Fourth anti-Confucian emancipation with selective cultural synthesis.

citations.author: Chen Hengzhe
citations.work: The Chinese Woman and Other Essays

label: Pioneered modern Chinese vernacular women’s writing and feminist intellectual voice
description: Publishing China’s first modern vernacular short story in 1917, Chen opened the literary-philosophical space for Ding Ling’s radical exploration of female subjectivity.
dialecticalTension: Transitions from cosmopolitan educational reform to revolutionary psychological critique.
historicalContext: Modern Chinese literary and social thought (1917–1928).
